_metadata.description: Test Genie provider phase for AI inference conformance.

requirements.title: Conformance phase inventories AI integration patterns in target scenarios
requirements.description: The test-genie phase must detect AI-adjacent env vars, provider URLs, resource command usage, concrete model slugs, embedding dimensions, vector-store metadata, and gateway adoption evidence.

validation.notes: Validates detection fixtures for direct Ollama, provider secret env vars, concrete model slugs, and embedding metadata patterns.
Validates the conformance RPC exposes scanner findings.

requirements.title: Conformance findings follow an explicit maturity ladder
requirements.description: The phase must support advisory lower-maturity checks and stricter higher-maturity gateway adoption checks, with approved exceptions and fix guidance for every finding class.

validation.notes: Validates maturity taxonomy findings, severity mapping inputs, and exception handling.
Validates ScenarioValidationService returns a shared maturity assessment.
Provider descriptor passes test-genie provider-contract validation.
